suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved without a single "nit:" comment.
I'm thankful for the sound of rain starting right as I close my laptop for the day.
I'm grateful for nasi lemak that's still warm by the time I get to my desk.
I'm thankful for a bug that turned out to be a missing semicolon and not three days of my life.
I'm grateful for the five minutes after Maghrib when the whole house finally goes quiet.
I'm thankful for my mom texting "makan dah?" even though I'm well past the age she needs to ask.
I'm grateful for a Grab driver who didn't try small talk on a day I clearly needed the silence.
I'm thankful for CI turning green on the first try, no re-run needed.
I'm grateful for the uncle at the mamak who remembers my teh o ais kurang manis without me saying it.
I'm thankful for a Friday the office let out early enough to make it for Jumaat prayers.
I'm grateful for finding parking right in front of the building on a day I was already running late.
I'm thankful for a senior engineer who actually walked me through the legacy code instead of saying "just figure it out."
I'm grateful for the breeze through the window before Fajr, before the heat sets in for the day.
I'm thankful for a group project where everyone actually pulled their weight for once.
I'm grateful for payday landing the same week rent is due, timing that never gets old.
